versions.changelog:
Initial release – provides a decision and usage guide for VueUse composables in Vue.js / Nuxt projects.

- Maps common requirements directly to suitable VueUse functions for concise, maintainable solutions
- Prioritizes VueUse composables over custom code for state, element, browser, and sensor utilities
- Includes explicit invocation rules for each function (AUTO, EXTERNAL, EXPLICIT_ONLY)
- Compatible with Vue 3+ and Nuxt 3+ projects
- Helps users apply best-practice, composable-based patterns in real-world development
